description: Delivered audit disclosures of confidential ring transfers at capacity 8, one case per layout: dense, exits, escrow and exits_escrow. Encodings, fixed inputs, layout and the exit and dummy blindings as in audit-disclosure.json, plus the domain tag CRDS. A ring output has slot_secret = Poseidon(CRDS, pack_be(X25519(tx_viewing_sk, recipient_u)), pack_be(0x04 || tx_viewing_u), pack_be(0x04 || recipient_u), salt, i, n0), ring_secret = Poseidon(CRRC, slot_secret), blinding = Poseidon(TXRB, n0, ring_secret, i) and body = AES-256-CTR(asset_address || u64be(amount)) under the audit stream key and nonce of slot_secret (info CRING/adt1), its data hashes zero. The owner tag of a ring output is its recipient_u, a dummy's owner tag and body are random. plaintext: seed_out first when an output exits, then the nullifier_pk of every slot (0 on a dummy) unless key_escrow, then pack_disclosure of the eight slots, 40 bytes each when an output exits (a ring output owner_key || 0^8, an exit asset || u64be(amount), a dummy zeros), 32 bytes otherwise (a ring output owner_key, a dummy zeros). pad, published and disclosure_chain as in audit-disclosure.json. Generated by custom-rings/client/tests/disclosure_vectors.rs.
